Read: this card and objectui#10805 (no comments on either), objectui#10748 (closed, the previous closure card), and PRs objectui#10792 and objectui#10800 (both merged).

**Why this is the closure card now.** objectui#10748 closed `completed` when PR objectui#10800 merged, so the family has no open carrier. These two cards come from the same dev report (`5857433868`, `out_of_scope_findings` 1–3), in the same package, with the same fix shape and the same pins. objectui#10805 is closed as folded into this one. A designer surface later found in English under zh-CN rides here.

**No serial constraint.** PRs objectui#10792 and objectui#10800 both merged on 2026-09-27, so the order this card named is spent.

**Execution notes.**
1. Sites 1 and 2: pass the designer locale, as the sibling `FlowEdgeInspector` and `FlowNodeConfigField` already do.
2. Site 3 and objectui#10805's strings: add `engine.*` rows with en equal to today's literal, plus zh. For chart names, use the terms `packages/i18n`'s `widgetType` rows already use (柱状图, 折线图 …).
3. **objectui#10805's reader split, decided here.** `WIDGET_TYPE_META[].label` also writes the default `New TYPE` title of a new widget. That title is stored author data, on the objectui#10678 / objectui#10651 「left literal on purpose」 list. The picker shows the localized label; the default title keeps writing today's English. Split the reader, and ⛔ do not re-rule the stored title in this PR. The stored `type` does not move.
4. One zh pin per site through the real component, each with an en control (template: objectui#10741's `inspectorStrings.i18n-10696.test.tsx`).

- the `engine.*` rows in `i18n.ts`.

Also the tests beside them, and one `.changeset/10804-…md` (`'@object-ui/app-shell': patch`). ⛔ Not `ViewPreview.tsx` (open PR objectui#10821).

- Seat 4's claims on objectui#10813 and objectui#10814 cover other files; objectui#10813 holds only `datasetFilterCondition.ts` in this directory.
